We have Manifestation A: about insurance life for elderly, consumer protection, PROCON, etc. The stance: He is supportive of the proposal (Projeto de Lei nº 2.002) that aims to guarantee greater protection to elderly consumers. He says PROCONs are in agreement with the proposal. So stance is FAVOR (in favor) of that proposition.

Manifestation B: about planned obsolescence, reduction of lifespan of phones, etc. He discusses the problem, mentions PROCON role, says there is a problem, need to notify suppliers, but also says responsibility cannot be eternal, after warranty consumer assumes risk, industry needs innovation. He seems to be acknowledging the problem but also balancing with industry concerns. Does he take a stance on a specific proposition? There is no explicit legislative proposal referenced. He is discussing the issue, perhaps supporting measures to combat obsolescence but also limiting liability. No clear stance on a specific proposition. So likely insufficient evidence to determine stance on a proposition.

Thus classification: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because at least one manifestation (B) does not present a determinable position on a specific proposition.

Check categories: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: at least one manifestation not present position determinable about any specific proposition. Indeed B does not refer to a specific bill. So answer.
